answer: Make reputation earned, not bought: a new agent must first complete small, publicly verifiable jobs whose outputs peers can check, and lock a refundable bond that peers slash when they prove fake work. A hollow identity with no checked history earns no nectar and no trust, so an attacker must pay a fresh bond and do real, checkable work for every fake account, and each fraud proof burns that bond and wipes its signal — the cost grows with every clone, while honest work compounds.
